chain.title: Fire Under the Floor
chain.desc: Craft from iron, planks, copper, osmium and a furnace; it burns solid fuel for FE and passively drinks heat from adjacent lava.

chain.title: Wafer of Daylight
chain.desc: Craft from glass panes, redstone dust, an infused alloy and osmium ingots; three panels form the face of a Solar Generator.

chain.title: Standing in the Sun
chain.desc: Craft three solar panels over infused alloy, iron, an energy tablet and osmium; it makes free FE under open sky.

chain.title: Higher Is Windier
chain.desc: Craft from osmium, an infused alloy, an energy tablet and a basic control circuit; its FE output scales with the altitude you place it at.

chain.title: Compost Into Current
chain.desc: Craft from redstone, infused alloys, bio fuel, a basic control circuit and iron; it burns Bio Fuel milled out of plant matter in the Crusher.

chain.title: Ethylene Ignition
chain.desc: Craft from osmium, infused alloys, two steel casings and an electrolytic core; it burns hydrogen or Ethylene and out-produces every earlier generator combined.

chain.title: Four Suns in One Frame
chain.desc: Craft from four Solar Generators, infused alloys and iron; the advanced panel unfolds on placement and is the last passive generator worth building.

chain.title: Electromagnetic Coil
chain.desc: Craft from steel ingots, gold ingots and an energy tablet; it is the electrical core of the Industrial Turbine.

chain.title: Rotational Complex
chain.desc: Craft from steel, infused alloys and advanced control circuits; it couples the spinning rotor shaft to the coil that actually makes power.

chain.title: Rotor Shaft
chain.desc: Craft from steel ingots and infused alloys; rotors stack up the centre column of the turbine, one per level of height.

chain.title: Blades on the Shaft
chain.desc: Craft from steel and an infused alloy; two blades slot onto every rotor and set how much steam the turbine can swallow per tick.

chain.title: Turbine Casing
chain.desc: Craft four at a time from steel and osmium; the casing skins the whole Industrial Turbine multiblock.

chain.title: Steam In, Power Out
chain.desc: Craft two at a time from turbine casings and an advanced control circuit; valves are the only faces that accept steam and emit FE.

chain.title: Closing the Loop
chain.desc: Craft from steel, tin and a bucket; it condenses spent steam back into water so a boiler and turbine can run forever on one fill.

chain.title: Fission Reactor Casing
chain.desc: Craft four at a time from lead ingots around a steel casing; this is the pressure shell of the Fission Reactor.

chain.title: Fuel Assembly
chain.desc: Craft from lead, steel and a basic chemical tank; stack assemblies into columns to hold the Fissile Fuel that actually burns.

chain.title: Control Rod Assembly
chain.desc: Craft from an elite control circuit, lead and steel; one assembly caps each fuel column and gives you a way to scram the reactor.

chain.title: Fission Reactor Port
chain.desc: Craft two at a time from fission casings and an elite control circuit; ports move coolant in and steam, waste and heat out.

chain.title: Rated for Fission
chain.desc: Craft four at a time from enriched iron, lead and silica glass; it is the only window the fission and fusion shells will accept.

chain.title: Fusion Reactor Frame
chain.desc: Craft four at a time from ultimate alloys, polonium pellets and a steel casing; polonium is fission waste, so the reactor you just built is what unlocks this one.

chain.title: The Ignition Pellet
chain.desc: Infuse four gold dust with carbon in the Metallurgic Infuser, then fill it with D-T fuel; it is the capsule the laser shoots to start fusion.

chain.title: Laser Focus Matrix
chain.desc: Craft two at a time from reactor glass and a block of redstone; the matrix takes the stored laser shot that lights the hohlraum.

chain.title: First Light
chain.desc: Craft from ultimate control circuits, fusion frames, a glass pane and a basic chemical tank; it runs the D-T burn that powers everything after it.

chain.title: Sunlight in the Suit
chain.desc: Craft from an Advanced Solar Generator, elite alloys, a Module Base and polonium pellets; install it in a MekaSuit helmet to recharge from daylight.

notes: Base Mekanism ships NO generators at all; this module owns the entire power line AND gates Mekanism's own endgame, because Polonium - and therefore the MekaSuit, Meka-Tool upgrades and Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer - only exists as Fission Reactor waste. Highest-value addon in this batch. ASSUMES FROM PARENT (mekanism): steel ingot, steel casing, enriched iron, infused/reinforced/atomic alloy, basic/advanced/elite/ultimate control circuits, energy tablet, basic chemical tank, electrolytic core, module base, polonium pellet, Metallurgic Infuser, Crusher (for Bio Fuel), Electrolytic Separator (for hydrogen), Rotary Condensentrator (gas to liquid deuterium/tritium/D-T fuel), and Fissile Fuel from the uranium chain. VERIFICATION: 31 ids from the strict assets/mekanismgenerators/models/item intersection with item./block. lang keys. WIDENED BY 2 - module_solar_recharging_unit and module_geothermal_generator_unit have item models and crafting_shaped recipes in data/mekanismgenerators/recipes but use module.* lang keys instead of item.*, so the strict intersection dropped them; both re-verified as recipe results. DROPPED: mekanismgenerators:bioethanol_bucket - the item and its model exist, but no recipe anywhere in this jar produces Bioethanol, so its source is not verifiable from jar data alone. The four lang-only entries (bioethanol, deuterium, tritium, fusion_fuel) are fluids rather than items; only their _bucket forms are quested, and those are reachable via the Rotary Condensentrator.
